<b>Bellhart's Glory</b> is a [[Donate Wishes|Donate Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, found on the Wishwall of [[Bellhart]].

== Wish ==
To complete the Wish, donate {{R|400}} to the Bellhart Wishwall. <i>Bellhart's Glory</i> is a prerequisite Wish required to unlock the <i>[[Silk and Soul]]</i> Wish and to obtain the [[Bellhome Key]].
